description: This is the main activity code for an Android Wearable app that manages connections with Google Play services and handles messaging between devices. It sets up GoogleApiClient, listens for messages, and sends messages to connected nodes upon user interaction.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for wearable device, managing GoogleApiClient connection, message reception, and sending messages upon user interaction.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes GoogleApiClient and sets the content view.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Adds message listener when GoogleApiClient is connected.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Removes message listener when connection is suspended.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages and shows appropriate toasts.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Logs error if connection to GoogleApiClient fails.

methods.name: onStartWearableActivityClick
methods.description: Sends a start activity message to connected wearable nodes when button is clicked.

methods.name: getSendMessageResultCallback
methods.description: Handles the result callback after attempting to send a message.
